Arrange the five white donuts together in one clearly separated group, and arrange the two plastic cookies together in a separate group. All seven items must be fully visible, non-overlapping, unobstructed, and easy to count. The donuts must be white, and the cookies must clearly look plastic. Do not include any additional donuts, additional cookies, or other objects.
